items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Luka Garza made 3 of his 4 3s in the Celtics' win last night. He's shooting 11/21 [52.4%] from beyond the arc this season.

Garza had the NBA's highest 3P% among centers last year. Would love to see him in this year's 3-Point Contest.

items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Luka Garza: 2/2 from beyond the arc, 2 ORebs, 1 steal

He's a +12 and has worked well in double-big lineups. Some good screens, too. Garza's shifts are consistently productive.

items.title: The Celtics had Luka Garza on A.J. Green in the low post, but they couldn't get to it fast enough. Instead, Neemias Queta nearly put Kasparas Jakučionis on a poster.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
The Celtics had Luka Garza on A.J. Green in the low post, but they couldn't get to it fast enough. Instead, Neemias Queta nearly put Kasparas Jakučionis on a poster. 

Queta got fouled on the attempt and went 1/2 at the line. Boston leads 28-11 near the end of the first frame.

items.title: Last season, Luka Garza got the opportunity he was waiting for. He took the most significant step of his career.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Last season, Luka Garza got the opportunity he was waiting for. He took the most significant step of his career.

Now, he's on a depth chart that, along with Neemias Queta, includes Mitchell Robinson. As always, he's ready to fight.

It also helps to have a coach who cares as much as Joe Mazzulla:

media.title: Joe Mazzulla on Luka Garza's role in Celtics' frontcourt: 'Fighting his whole life'
media.description: At Celtics training camp on Monday, Joe Mazzulla shared his offseason message to Luka Garza. Despite the challenge, Garza is once again ready to persevere.

items.title: I asked Joe Mazzulla about his message to Luka Garza this offseason, as he tries to build on last year while fighting for playing time on a depth chart with Neemi and Mitch:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
I asked Joe Mazzulla about his message to Luka Garza this offseason, as he tries to build on last year while fighting for playing time on a depth chart with Neemi and Mitch:

“You trust the guy because of his character and who he is…The second thing is, he’s used to fighting his whole life.”
